name: critic-loop
description: Bounded writer↔critic refinement: a draft step feeds a critic, and a marked loop edge — the only sanctioned kind of cycle — sends the run back to the draft step while the critic asks for revisions, up to max_iterations. Demonstrates loop edges (condition + max_iterations, executed by unrolling) and a conditioned exit edge.

config.prompt:
Write an article for this brief. If the blackboard has critique notes, address every one of them.

${{ run.params.brief }}
Review the latest draft against the brief. Output JSON like {"verdict": "approve"} or {"verdict": "revise", "notes": ["..."]}.
